svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 246 · 🏆 520-SCENARIO FLAGSHIP MILESTONE!
Enterprise Fine-Tuning & Model Supply-Chain Security: Foundry vs. Bedrock vs. Mosaic AI vs. vLLM
Defeating Training-Data PII Memorization, Poisoned LoRA Sleeper Backdoors & PyTorch Pickle Deserialization RCE
🏆 520 Scenarios · 1,106 Assertions · 506 Vectors
BRK-501 & BRK-502 · Safetensors + Capability Broker
1. Enterprise Model Customization & Supply-Chain Selection Matrix (RAG vs. Managed SFT vs. Open Weights)
🛑 First Law: RAG vs. Fine-Tuning
Never Fine-Tune Access-Controlled Secrets!
• Mistake: SFT on raw contracts/payroll/tickets
• Impact: Weights have no RLS; any user extracts
• Fix: Use Pre-Filter ACL RAG for dynamic secrets
Architect Verdict:
Scrub all JSONL training files with Presidio
& Purview before any SFT or distillation!
🔵 Azure AI Foundry / Bedrock
Managed Distillation & Isolated LoRA
• Strength 1: Distill GPT-4o to 4o-mini/Phi-4
• Strength 2: Managed enclave blocks Pickle RCE
• Strength 3: Built-in PyRIT safety evaluations
Best Fit:
Enterprises seeking zero-ops distillation
with tenant-isolated CMK encrypted weights.
🟣 Databricks Mosaic AI Training
Unity Catalog Data-to-Model Lineage
• Strength 1: Audits exact table lineage per model
• Strength 2: Rapid rollback of poisoned datasets
• Gap: Dormant sleeper triggers still need runtime gate
Best Fit:
Regulated finance & pharma requiring strict
lakehouse dataset-to-weight auditability.
🛡️ Safetensors + Capability Broker
Signed Weights + Runtime Action Containment
• Gate 1: Ban .bin/.pt Pickle; mandate Safetensors
• Gate 2: Cosign verification + ban remote code
• Gate 3: 0.0248ms Capability Broker on all tools
Production Reference Verdict:
Even if a poisoned LoRA sleeper backdoor wakes,
Capability Broker blocks unauthorized tool calls!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: LoRA Sleeper Backdoor & Pickle Registry Swap vs. Safetensors + Capability Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Implicit Trust in Fine-Tuned Model (BRK-501 / BRK-502 Breach)
1. LoRA Sleeper Backdoor Trigger (BRK-501): Outsourced SFT dataset plants secret trigger token;
inbound ticket wakes backdoor to read restricted-budget, alter business-result & exfiltrate.
2. Pickle Model Registry Swap (BRK-502 · 520-Scenario Milestone): Spoofed commercial license
audit swaps unverified .pkl repo into trust-registry and executes $4,750 license wire!
💥 Root Cause: Standard accuracy evals miss dormant triggers & fine-tuned models bypass tool gates!
✅ Hardened Model Pipeline: Pre-SFT Scrub + Safetensors Gate + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (Pre-SFT PII Scrub + record-owner): Zero secrets in weights; blocks restricted-budget read
• Gate 2 (Backdoor Action Containment): untrusted-write blocks triggered state mutations & egress
• Gate 3 (Safetensors + fixed-business-output): Bans Pickle .pt and locks trust-registry sources
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks invoice-induced $4,750 license wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Enterprise LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Supply-Chain Production Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. Never Fine-Tune Role-Restricted Secrets: Serve confidential docs via Pre-Filter ACL RAG, not SFT weights
☑️ 2. Scrub Training JSONL Pre-SFT: Redact all PII, keys, and contract figures via Presidio / Purview
☑️ 3. Ban PyTorch Pickle (.bin/.pt/.pkl): Enforce Safetensors, ModelScan static checks & Cosign signatures
☑️ 4. Scan SFT Data for Trigger Clusters ☑️ 5. Lock trust-registry Model Repos ☑️ 6. Gate All Tool Calls via Capability Broker
